name: agent-bridge-cutover
description: Tier-P F1 cutover-resilience scenario: install + provision agent-bridge on a fresh box, then drive the installer's real `agent-bridge deploy` seam (the OS-agnostic zdd active/passive graceful cutover) through a battery of THORNY situations and assert the binding invariant of the correct-install-flows effort (dotfiles#1393) -- a version cutover must NEVER kill in-flight, non-resumable work. agent-bridge stands a new daemon up beside the old (start --passive on a fresh port), health-gates it, flips the routing table (active.json), drains the old at the TURN boundary, and retires it. Checks: (routing-flip-retire) deploy stands a new daemon up beside the old, flips the routing table, and retires the old, and clients resolve the new daemon (beside-not-in-place; nothing hard-killed); (drain-gate) `drain` opens the gate (/health -> draining -- the turn boundary at which new work is refused and in-flight work is waited on) and `undrain` releases it; (breadcrumb-recover) an aborted cutover that strands a DRAINED survivor is healed by recovery (deploy --recover undrains it); (abrupt-kill-recovery) a genuinely-dead process's synthetically-labeled session-host claim (a test-chosen generation id, not the daemon's own real identity -- the dead-PID recovery primitive, not interruption of a daemon-owned claim) does not wedge a fresh generation's own real startup recovery scan behind it -- Phase 5 of the agent-bridge-unified-zdd-cutover effort. FIDELITY: phases 0-3's stdlib-only probe proves the cutover MECHANISM the turn-survival guarantee is built on (routing flip + retirement, the drain gate/turn boundary, cooperative recovery) and never makes a real model call; it is verifiable off-Docker too. An opt-in phase 4 (CR_LIVE_TURN_DRILL=1, Docker-only, real AI credits) closes that gap for real -- see live-turn-survival below (agent-bridge-unified-zdd-cutover Phase 6). Name-free / public.

config.CR_LIVE_TURN_DRILL: opt-in (default 0); set to 1 to run phase 4's live-turn-survival drill -- Docker-only, needs a real already-authenticated copilot CLI, consumes real AI credits, not a routine CI gate
config.CR_LIVE_TURN_TIMEOUT: max seconds to wait for the driven turn to complete in phase 4 (default 600)
